title: Marketing Analytics
text:
Data Analysis


Garcia Research MAS Project

Marketing Accessibility Scorecard also known as MAS, focused on evaluating how brands show accessibility and inclusivity across digital consumer touchpoints.

Using structured scoring framework, brands were evaluated on areas such as website, apps, customer service over the phone, promotion, terms and warning, visual appearance, and follow-up communication. This project help highlight the importance of accessibility and inclusive marketing.
Analysis was done by measuring inter-rater reliability using intraclass correlation coefficient (ICC) analysis to evaluate the consistency between elevators. It helped show reliability of MAS framework and identify which dimensions show high agreement in order for it to further help clients in areas that show strong need for improvement.




Key Areas

Marketing Accessibility
Inter-rater reliability (ICC)
Dashboard Visualization
Tableau
Data Visualization

Tools and What We Found



Google Analytics 4
Website traffic and engagement data


BigQuery
GA4 event-level data and validation


Looker Studio
Interactive dashboard and visual reporting


Insights

Direct traffic generated the highest session volume, but engagement was low.
Organic Search and Referral showed stronger engagement.
NCMA SGV should not only focus on direct traffic volume. Organic Search and Referral should also receive credit because they may support early user interest and improve engaged sessions.
